chat: I have a window cleaning robot for glass towers in Dubai. Dubai has sandstorms. Some buildings are very high up, so they get very strong winds. Some have high moisture and high humidity, some have low friction and some high friction, and some have weird edges. It also gets very hot.
count_reason: Eight groups cover the user's named hazards. Wind, gusts and edges are the harshest and widest, so they get most worlds. Friction, heat and dust get fewer. Total is 52, below the cap of 60.

requirements.text: The body stays on the glass: gap under 0.03 m, or over it for less than 0.1 s, with its centre on the glass.
Tether load stays at or under 1000 N.
No single slide on the glass goes further than 0.3 m.
When the robot reports done, reported coverage is within 0.1 of true coverage.
True coverage is at least 0.9, unless the run ends in a safe hold.
The robot finishes within 600 s, or holds still on the glass for the last 30 s for a stated reason: wind or low battery.
The robot does not stop on the glass with no reason: not 30 s of wind under 7.0 m/s without a battery reason.

fix.source: campaign_dubai_v4, try 2, then the larger test written down in retest_2026-11-06/PLAN.md before it ran. No AI call was made now.

tables.head: Larger test, new held-back worlds, sim 0e36d3bf
First test of the same patch, older sim aac6648b

fix.conclusion: helped on the counts but removed the low-pressure guard in the clean phase. Not recommended as it stands.
fix.plain: On 104 new worlds: 6 failed and now pass. 1 did not pass either way, and changed: 1 stalled to battery stop. That is the report's 7 better. 1 moved between failure types (slip distance to stalled). 0 got worse. The patch removes the low-pressure guard while cleaning, and we have not applied it.
caveats: The patch raises clean-phase suction to 0.9. At that speed the lowest pressure estimate is 1512.0 Pa, and the guard fires only under 1500.0 Pa. So the low-pressure guard can no longer fire in the clean phase.
Try 2 raised SUCTION_CLEAN to 0.9, past the 0.896 speed where the low-pressure guard goes blind. The A/B does not measure that loss.
Separately, a live AI fix try in the app, on a 11-world check run and 12 held-back worlds, found 0 better and 0 worse, and it did not help.

sandbox.note: sandbox-exec is not a VM. It shares the kernel with the host.

fix_summary: Recorded result. On 104 new worlds: 6 failed and now pass. 1 did not pass either way, and changed: 1 stalled to battery stop. That is the report's 7 better. 1 moved between failure types (slip distance to stalled). 0 got worse. The patch removes the low-pressure guard while cleaning, and we have not applied it. Conclusion: helped on the counts but removed the low-pressure guard in the clean phase. Not recommended as it stands.

groups.name: High steady wind
groups.reason: Tall towers see strong sustained wind; tests tether and suction hold. Height-based wind profile itself not tested.

groups.name: Strong gusts on high facade
groups.reason: Gusts at height can peel or swing the robot; varies speed, timing and direction.

groups.name: Dust on glass and seal
groups.reason: Sandstorm: dust load on glass and leak tested; airborne sand hitting sensors and pads not tested.

groups.name: Wet humid low friction glass
groups.reason: High moisture and humidity lower friction; rain itself not tested, only wet glass.

groups.name: Dry high friction glass
groups.reason: Changes humidity_pct, pad_force_n, wetness only. Dust on the glass not tested.

groups.name: Weird edges and joints
groups.reason: Odd edges, proud mullions, wide joint gaps and ledges can break seal or block travel.

groups.name: Extreme heat with weak battery
groups.reason: Very hot air stresses battery and suction; low start charge tests return margin.

groups.name: Weak suction with wind
groups.reason: Reduced suction and leaky seal combined with strong wind on a high, smooth facade.

not_tested.reason: No physics for sand hitting sensors, pads or impeller; only dust on glass is tested.

not_tested.factor: Building height and wind by height
not_tested.reason: Wind does not scale with height; tall-tower wind is mimicked only with high wind and tether drop.
Heat is tested as air and battery temperature only; solar heating of glass and sensor glare are not modelled.
Only the simulated robot is tested, not real motors, sensors or tether wear.

not_tested.factor: Rain, ice and snow, salt corrosion
not_tested.reason: No physics for these; wet glass only approximates moisture.
